settings.visualStyle: Normandy D-Day Omaha Beach 1944 historical reenactment, embedded shoreline field-camera realism, cold grey surf, spray, smoke, beach obstacles, wet sand, shingle and bluff approaches. Historically plausible U.S. Army uniforms, M1 helmets and landing equipment, muted wartime color, non-graphic combat, no modern objects.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Follow one fictional U.S. infantryman from landing craft to shallow water, obstacles, shingle cover, short rushes, bluff approach and inland movement. No dialogue or narrator. One primary action and one camera movement per scene. Preserve wetness, sand, smoke and gear continuity.
settings.customVisualStyle: Cold wet D-Day field-film aesthetic with sea spray on clothing, smoke blowing inland, heavy gear, short exposed movement, brief lulls behind cover and restrained camera shake.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite U.S. Army infantryman used only as a continuity anchor within a historically plausible Omaha Beach assault environment.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute historical reenactment of an Omaha Beach assault on D-Day. Follow one fictional U.S. infantryman from landing craft ramp to shallow surf, beach obstacles, shingle cover, brief supporting fire, exposed movement and the first climb away from open sand. Keep violence non-graphic and geographically readable. No dialogue or narrator. Do not copy an identifiable shot from a specific film.
movie.storySummary: A U.S. infantryman braces inside a landing craft as the ramp drops onto rough surf. He wades through shallow water, passes obstacles and sprints to the shingle. Pinned for a moment, the section returns brief fire and moves by short rushes across the exposed beach. The soldier reaches the base of the bluff, catches one breath, and follows the unit inland while the beach recedes behind them.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP08 — Normandy 1944: Omaha Beach Assault

scenes.title: Inside the Landing Craft
scenes.description: Packed infantry braces as the landing craft pitches toward shore.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman grips a wet steel handhold while men around him lean with the motion of the craft.
scenes.imageDescription: June 1944 landing craft interior, U.S. Army infantry, wet steel, M1 helmets, heavy field gear, grey daylight, sea spray, historically plausible equipment.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld cramped shot with boat motion, staying close to the lead soldier. Audio: engine, hull vibration, waves, gear, breathing. No speech.

scenes.title: Ramp Drops
scenes.description: The front ramp falls and the beach abruptly fills the frame.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman moves with the first group off the ramp into shallow water.
scenes.imageDescription: Open landing craft ramp, grey surf, smoke-covered beach ahead, U.S. infantry moving out, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: One reveal from dark craft interior to bright smoky beach as the ramp opens. Audio: ramp crash, surf, distant gunfire, engine.

scenes.title: Into the Surf
scenes.description: Heavy gear makes every step through the water slow and unstable.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman wades forward while spray hits his uniform and the section spreads around him.
scenes.imageDescription: Water-level D-Day approach, U.S. infantry waist-to-knee-deep in surf, obstacles ahead, smoke, wet uniforms and helmets.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low waterline handheld move following the soldier forward. Audio: splashing, surf, gear, distant gunfire, breath.

scenes.title: Steel Obstacles
scenes.description: The soldier passes between beach obstacles as the water becomes shallower.
scenes.actionDescription: He angles around a steel obstacle and continues toward dry sand.
scenes.imageDescription: Omaha obstacle zone, wet steel hedgehogs, surf, smoke and U.S. infantry moving inland, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tracking shot weaving once around one obstacle. Audio: surf, metal clang, boots, distant rounds.

scenes.title: Run to the Shingle
scenes.description: The infantryman makes one short exposed dash from wet sand to the shingle bank.
scenes.actionDescription: He runs low across open sand and drops behind the gravel bank.
scenes.imageDescription: Open wet beach, smoke, scattered obstacles, shingle bank ahead, U.S. soldier sprinting with rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast rear handheld run ending in a hard drop behind shingle. Audio: boots, gunfire, gear, breathing.

scenes.title: Pinned Low
scenes.description: The first cover is shallow and the men remain compressed against the ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman lies low, catching breath while other men arrive behind the same bank.
scenes.imageDescription: Low gravel cover, wet uniforms, smoke, tired infantry, no active firing in this beat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still close shot with slight field-camera tremble. Audio: breath, gravel, distant gunfire and surf.

scenes.title: Brief Supporting Fire
scenes.description: The line returns controlled fire toward the bluff positions.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman raises just above cover and fires a short controlled sequence.
scenes.imageDescription: Shingle line, smoke, rifleman partially exposed, weapon offset, bluff terrain distant, non-graphic combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder shot with brief firing then duck back down. Audio: rifle shots, gravel impacts, surf.

scenes.title: Obstacle to Crater
scenes.description: The squad moves from the shingle toward a shallow crater or obstacle base.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman makes one short rush and drops into the new cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Smoke-heavy beach, obstacle remains, shallow crater, small groups moving by short bounds.
scenes.videoPrompt: One quick exposed movement ending abruptly low. Audio: boots, gear, distant shots, sand debris.

scenes.title: Look Toward the Bluff
scenes.description: From the new cover the route inland becomes visible for the first time.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stays low and studies the rising ground beyond the beach.
scenes.imageDescription: View from shallow beach cover toward bluff approaches, smoke and scattered troops, rifleman low foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow tilt from gravel cover upward to inland terrain. Audio: surf, wind, distant gunfire, breathing.

scenes.title: Move Through Wire Gap
scenes.description: The section finds a narrow route through damaged obstacles and wire.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman ducks through the gap behind another soldier.
scenes.imageDescription: Damaged beach wire and obstacle gap, U.S. infantry passing carefully, smoke and wet sand, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low forward move through the obstacle gap. Audio: metal vibration, boots, wind, distant firing.

scenes.title: Base of the Rise
scenes.description: The men reach slightly better cover at the foot of rising ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier drops beside a sandy embankment and checks his muddy wet sleeves.
scenes.imageDescription: Base of bluff approach, sandy earth, grass, exhausted wet infantry, beach smoke behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium push-in as the soldier settles behind earth cover. Audio: breathing, distant battle, surf farther away.

scenes.title: One Breath
scenes.description: A brief quiet beat lets the soldier breathe before the next climb.
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers his rifle, wipes seawater and sand from his face and looks upward.
scenes.imageDescription: Close exhausted soldier beside sandy embankment, wet helmet strap, sand on face, rifle resting low, no nearby combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet close shot from hands to face. Audio: breathing, distant artillery, muted surf.

scenes.title: Climb Inland
scenes.description: The section begins climbing away from the exposed beach.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman climbs the rough slope behind two comrades.
scenes.imageDescription: Sandy grassy slope, smoke below, U.S. soldiers climbing carefully, same lead soldier wet and sandy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld uphill follow with natural body weight. Audio: boots in sand, breath, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Beach Below
scenes.description: From higher ground the smoke-covered shoreline is visible behind the unit.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses once and looks back toward landing craft and the obstacle-filled beach.
scenes.imageDescription: Elevated view back over Omaha shoreline, landing craft, smoke, tiny troops and obstacles, soldier foreground profile.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from soldier to wide beach view and hold. Audio: wind, distant surf, battlefield rumble.

scenes.title: Inland
scenes.description: The squad disappears beyond the crest while the beach battle continues behind them.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman follows the section away from the shoreline into inland terrain.
scenes.imageDescription: U.S. infantry moving beyond sandy crest toward hedged inland route, smoke behind, no victory celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long rear follow shot away from the beach. Audio: boots, wind, distant battle, restrained score tail.

characters.name: Landing Infantryman
characters.description: Anonymous U.S. Army infantryman in historically plausible 1944 D-Day field gear, M1 helmet, rifle, web equipment and heavy pack.

continuity.continuityRules: Same face, M1 helmet, rifle and web gear. Clothing becomes soaked in Scenes 2–4 and remains wet and sandy throughout; no clean reset.

props.personalProps: rifle, M1 helmet, web gear, assault pack
